core_meaning.primary_meaning: Babacar is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Abubakar (Wolof form)”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Babacar corresponds to the Arabic form أَبُو بَكْر (Arabic أَبُو (abū, father of) + بَكْر (Bakr)). Its core sense is babacar; abubakar (wolof form). Babacar is the Wolof (Senegalese) form of Arabic أَبُو بَكْر (Abū Bakr), meaning 'father of Bakr'.
